scope: One bounded long-window realization run of the unchanged required Nix checks with normal settings and frozen source and pins, followed by the identical 3500-second sequence to record acceptance, and the repository flake gate only if all three checks pass

stage_one_long_window.purpose: Allow cold closure evaluation and realization to finish once under current host contention; this run is not itself the acceptance record

stage_two_acceptance_record.condition: Run only after stage one completes with exit 0 and timed_out false; rerun the identical authorized sequence to record acceptance

stage_three_repository_gate.condition: Run only if stage two reports exit 0 and timed_out false and the preserved source binding still matches

non_claims: The long window is a realization run, not acceptance evidence by itself
A passing long-window run does not waive the required identical 3500-second acceptance run or the repository flake gate
No source, pin, host configuration, service, or unrelated-process change is authorized by this record
maintenance_owner: Molten maintainers own the retained acceptance evidence; host operator owns daemon and pool state
